title: Antique Pewter Paper Towel Holder, 14-Inch Freestanding Solid Brass Countertop Stand, Contemporary Style, Allied Brass
description: This 14-inch freestanding paper towel holder keeps a kitchen roll within easy reach while reducing countertop clutter. Available in Antique Pewter. Antique Pewter offers a soft, silvery-gray tone with subtle warmth,. Solid brass construction with a weighted base helps prevent tipping, and a felt pad helps protect surfaces from scratches. The compact footprint measures 5 in. L x 5 in. W, making it easy to place beside the sink, stove, or prep area without wall mounting. Designed in a crisp, contemporary style and available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes for easy coordination. Includes the paper towel holder and is backed by a limited lifetime warranty.
